primary: evidence_membership_rate = membership-valid candidate evidence strings / all emitted candidates
zero_candidate_rule: All candidate-denominator rates are null; status is UNINFORMATIVE_ZERO_CANDIDATES. Null is neither pass nor failure and cannot trigger any interpretation predicate.
evidence_alias_rule: Every candidate must emit exactly one of evidence or evidence_quote. Both and neither are schema-invalid. The accepted value is normalized to evidence without changing exact membership checks; registered_field_name_rate measures matches to the cell schema name.
membership: JavaScript String.prototype.includes over source, target, and source_context when present; no normalization
source_target_only_membership: JavaScript String.prototype.includes over source and target only; no normalization. This restricted rate is used for context-versus-baseline interpretation.

explanatory_prose_heuristic.count_if: evidence contains sentence punctuation [.!?。！？] or a frozen marker (because, since, therefore, means, indicates, shows, the translation, the source, the target, 因为, 所以, 说明, 表示, 译文, 原文), case-insensitive where applicable
explanatory_prose_heuristic.pattern: [.!?。！？]|because|since|therefore|means|indicates|shows|the translation|the source|the target|因为|所以|说明|表示|译文|原文
explanatory_prose_heuristic.reporting: Report proxy counts separately for membership-valid and membership-invalid evidence.
explanatory_prose_heuristic.upper_bound_caveat: Because a valid quoted substring may contain sentence-final punctuation, the unsplit proxy total is only an upper bound on explanatory prose and is never a correctness judgment.

interpretation_reporting: Every interpretation records supporting candidate counts and rates plus the fixed caveat that all cells are single unreplicated samples under unpinned decoding.
